text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: difference in mean quantile score, filtered forecasts, rows outside the switching events (C1, C4 and C5 at the five decision substations; C2 and C3 at the 8 MVA substations). Orange: scored year, 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026, with a 99% interval from resampling whole calendar months. Blue: replicate year, estimate only. Dashed line: no difference. C4 did not run because no capacity arm was identified. C5 is the unfiltered DP against unfiltered lagless XGBoost.'
text.tspan: Dot: difference in mean quantile score, filtered forecasts, rows outside the switching events
(C1, C4 and C5 at the five decision substations; C2 and C3 at the 8 MVA substations). Orange:
scored year, 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026, with a 99% interval from resampling whole calendar
months. Blue: replicate year, estimate only. Dashed line: no difference. C4 did not run because
no capacity arm was identified. C5 is the unfiltered DP against unfiltered lagless XGBoost.
